variants.text: We approved the migration to PostgreSQL.
The migration to PostgreSQL was approved.
Pay invoice INV-14 for $2,000.
Invoice INV-14 will be paid in the amount of $2,000.
Award contract CONT-45 to vendor VND-45 for $775k.
Vendor VND-45 wins contract CONT-45 worth $775,000.
Set customer CUST-91 discount to 24% through August 2025.
Customer CUST-91 receives a 24 percent discount until August 2025.
Apply a 24% discount to CUST-91 through August 2025.
Buy domain DOM-3779.example for campaign CMP-3779.
Campaign CMP-3779 will acquire domain DOM-3779.example.
Schedule maintenance WIN-760 on host HST-760 at 16:00 UTC.
Maintenance window WIN-760 for HST-760 starts at 16:00 UTC.
Host HST-760 maintenance WIN-760 is booked for 16:00 UTC.
Enable dark mode for the dashboard.
Dark mode will be enabled for the dashboard.
We approved enabling dark mode on the dashboard.
Allow employees three remote days per week.
Employees may work remotely three days each week.
A ten percent subscription price increase starts next quarter.
Increase subscription pricing ten percent next quarter.
Archive channel CH-10 to vault VT-10.
Channel CH-10 will be archived in vault VT-10.
Hire two backend engineers this quarter.
Recruit 2 backend developers this quarter.
Block public access to S3 buckets.
Public S3 buckets must be blocked.
Turn on fraud alerts for transactions above $5,000.
Enable transaction fraud notifications over five thousand dollars.
Fraud alerts will be enabled for transactions over $5,000.
Keep audit logs for 90 days.
Audit logs will be retained for ninety days.
Grant role ROLE-8 to service account SA-8.
Service account SA-8 is assigned ROLE-8.
ROLE-8 will be granted to service account SA-8.
Cancel the Acme vendor contract.
The Acme vendor contract will be cancelled.
Reject RFC-41 about feature FEAT-41.
RFC-41 for FEAT-41 has been rejected.
Cap wallet WAL-4026 spend at $52/day.
Set a daily $52 spending limit for wallet WAL-4026.
Close the Dhaka office on May 1.
The Dhaka location will shut down May 1.
The Dhaka office will be closed on May 1.
Deploy service checkout-api to staging on Tuesday.
The checkout-api staging deployment is scheduled for Tuesday.
Checkout-api will go to staging Tuesday.
Approve a hiring freeze for the design team.
The design team hiring freeze was approved.
Set KPI KPI-313 target to 30 for squad SQ-313.
Squad SQ-313 has a target of 30 on KPI-313.
Admin users must authenticate with a second factor.
Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for admins.
Launch the billing redesign in March.
Release the updated billing experience during March.
The billing redesign will launch in March.
Archive inactive support tickets after 60 days.
Tag inactive support tickets after 60 days.
Inactive support tickets will be archived after sixty days.
Continue hiring for the design team.
Review the design team hiring plan.
Switch customer billing from monthly to annual.
Invoice customers yearly instead of monthly.
Customer billing will move from monthly to annual.
Route region REG-1 traffic to cluster CLS-1.
Traffic from REG-1 will be routed to CLS-1.
Ship the mobile app on Friday.
The mobile application goes live Friday.
Promote employee EMP-3813 to level L6.
Employee EMP-3813 will advance to grade L6.
EMP-3813 was approved for promotion to L6.
Ship hotfix HF-42 for bug BUG-42 tonight.
Deploy hotfix HF-42 addressing BUG-42 this evening.
Move continuous integration to GitHub Actions.
CI pipelines will migrate to GitHub Actions.
We decided to migrate CI to GitHub Actions.
Restrict data exports to EU-hosted storage.
Exported data must remain in European Union storage.
Data exports will be limited to EU storage locations.
Decommission server SRV-18 after the migration.
Retire host SRV-18 once migration finishes.
Server SRV-18 will be decommissioned after migration.
Retire the legacy billing API by December.
Sunset the old billing API before year-end.
The legacy billing API will be retired by December.
Set priority-one incident SLA to one hour.
The P1 incident SLA is one hour.
Ban remote work three days per week.
Require three in-office days per week.
Rename project PRJ-65 to codename onyx65.
Project PRJ-65 will be called onyx65.
Rotate production API keys every 30 days.
Production API credentials must rotate monthly.
Production API keys will be rotated every thirty days.
Use PostgreSQL as the primary datastore.
Postgres will be our system of record.
The primary datastore will be PostgreSQL.
Block IP range 10.0.1.0/24 after incident INC-1.
Following INC-1, the 10.0.1.0/24 subnet will be blocked.
